segmentations.masks: the lungs and their nodules: 169 segmentations over 143 of the collection's 727 CT series, in IDC v24; the IDC fetch takes the CT series alone, so they are not on the grid
segmentations.by: BAMF Health, automatic, for IDC's analysis results, 26 of them semi-automatic

segmentations.masks: the tumour regions, which IDC's index codes as heart, tissue and upper arm: 144 segmentations over 144 of the collection's 727 CT series, in IDC v24; the IDC fetch takes the CT series alone, so they are not on the grid

how_to_get: Regenerate the tier-2 manifest idc_tier2.csv with spinesurg-ct-nnunet's tools/acquisition_census.py (its inputs aa3_meta.csv and fdg_ct_series.json are not on local disk), then slurm/acquisition_submit.sh tier2; or this one collection alone, filtering that manifest on its first column as the tier-1 cards do.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid idc_nsclc_radiogenomics; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="idc_nsclc_radiogenomics",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
